methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing was collected from each provider's own pricing page on the accessed date (2026-06-13); transactional email is billed as a flat monthly plan that bundles an included email volume, so monthlyUsd holds the published plan price and the included volume plus per-1,000-email overage rate are recorded in notes. Quote-only/Enterprise/Premier tiers are recorded with monthlyUsd null; HIPAA/BAA and minutes/calls/overage-per-min/per-call fields do not apply to email APIs and are null for every tier. Every figure is sourced to the fetched pricing page.

vendors.name: Resend
vendors.provenance: https://resend.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat monthly transactional plans with bundled email volume and per-1,000 overage tiers)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever: 3,000 emails/month, capped at 100 emails/day; 5 AI credits/month.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: 50,000 emails/month included, $0.90 per 1,000 overage; no daily sending limit; 100 AI credits/month; scales to $35/mo for 100,000 emails. Dedicated IP add-on $30/mo.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: Starts at $90/mo for 100,000 emails ($0.90 per 1,000 overage); tiers run to $160/200K, $350/500K, $650/1M, $825/1.5M, $1,150/2.5M with declining overage rates; 500 AI credits/month.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only; custom pricing for 3M+ emails/month, contact sales.

vendors.name: Postmark
vendors.provenance: https://postmarkapp.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat monthly plans bundling 10,000 emails with per-1,000 overage rates differing by tier)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100 emails/month, no overages allowed; 45-day data retention, up to 10 custom domains, unlimited emails/day, testing integration.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 10,000 emails/month included, $1.80 per 1,000 overage; 45-day retention, 5 custom domains, unlimited emails/day, detailed analytics.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Most popular. 10,000 emails/month included, $1.30 per 1,000 overage; customizable retention up to 365 days, 10 custom domains, inbound email processing. Dedicated IP add-on from $50/mo.

plans.name: Platform
plans.notes: 10,000 emails/month included, $1.20 per 1,000 overage; unlimited custom domains, unlimited users, customizable retention up to 365 days, inbound email processing.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only; custom pricing for senders exceeding 1.5 million emails/month, contact sales.

vendors.name: Twilio SendGrid
vendors.provenance: https://www.twilio.com/en-us/products/email-api/pricing (official Twilio SendGrid Email API pricing page; sendgrid.com/pricing 301-redirects here, accessed 2026-06-13; flat monthly plans by email volume)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free trial (60 days): 100 emails/day; APIs, SMTP relay, webhooks, dynamic template editor, ticket support, 2,500 email validations included.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Starting at $19.95/mo; up to 50,000 emails/month (100K tier also offered); APIs, SMTP relay, webhooks, dynamic templates, ticket and chat support.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: Most popular. Starting at $89.95/mo for up to 100,000 emails/month (scales to 2.5M tiers); 1 dedicated IP included, subuser management, SSO, ticket/chat/phone support, 2,500 free email validations.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: Quote-only; custom pricing for high-volume senders (5M+ emails/month), dedicated IPs, priority support, dedicated CSM, 5,000 email validations. Contact sales.

vendors.name: Amazon SES
vendors.provenance: https://aws.amazon.com/ses/pricing/ (official AWS pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; pure usage-based pricing with no flat monthly plans, so monthlyUsd is null and per-1,000 rates are recorded in notes)

plans.name: Pay-as-you-go (Outbound)
plans.notes: Usage-based, no flat fee: $0.10 per 1,000 emails sent, plus $0.12 per GB of attachment data. Free tier of up to 3,000 message charges/month for the first 12 months.

plans.name: Inbound
plans.notes: Usage-based: $0.10 per 1,000 emails received, plus $0.09 per 1,000 incoming email chunks.

plans.name: Dedicated IP (Standard)
plans.notes: Add-on: $24.95/month per standard dedicated IP. Managed dedicated IPs are $15/month per account plus tiered per-1,000 sending rates ($0.08/1K for 0-10M monthly, $0.04/1K for 10M-50M, $0.02/1K for 50M-100M).

vendors.name: Mailgun
vendors.provenance: https://www.mailgun.com/pricing/ (official Mailgun Send pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat monthly plans bundling email volume with per-1,000 overage rates)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 100 emails/day (~3,000/month); ticket support, 1 custom domain, 2 API keys, 1-day log retention.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: 10,000 emails/month included, $1.80 per 1,000 overage; no daily limit, 1 custom domain, 2 API keys, 1-day log retention. Email validations $1.20 per 100.

plans.name: Foundation
plans.notes: 50,000 emails/month included (first month free), $1.30 per 1,000 overage; up to 1,000 custom domains, email template builder, 5-day log retention. Validations $1.20 per 100.

plans.name: Scale
plans.notes: 100,000 emails/month included (first month free), $1.10 per 1,000 overage; SAML SSO, 5,000 validations included, dedicated IP pools, phone/chat support, 30-day log retention.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Quote-only; custom pricing with deliverability services and rapid-fire burst sending SLA. Contact sales.

vendors.name: MailerSend
vendors.provenance: https://www.mailersend.com/pricing (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat monthly plans bundling email volume with per-1,000 overage; annual billing discounts noted)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 500 emails/month, 100/day; drag & drop builder, 1 domain, 1 template, 1 user seat, no overages.

plans.name: Hobby
plans.notes: 5,000 emails/month included, $1.50 per 1,000 overage; Email API, SMTP relay, bulk emailing, 5 user seats, 3 templates. $7/mo monthly; $5.60/mo equivalent when billed annually ($67.20/yr, ~10% off).

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Starting at $35/mo for 50,000 emails/month included, $1.30 per 1,000 overage; sender identities, removable MailerSend logo, SMS API, 10 domains, 250 templates. $31.50/mo when billed annually (~10% off).

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Starting at $110/mo ($99/mo billed annually, ~10% off) for 50,000 emails/month included, $1.30 per 1,000 overage; dedicated account manager, deliverability consultation, 7-day API logs, unlimited domains/templates/seats, 500,000 daily API requests.

vendors.name: Mailtrap
vendors.provenance: https://mailtrap.io/pricing/ (official Email Sending pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat monthly plans with selectable volume bands and per-1,000 overage rates)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 4,000 emails/month, capped at 150 emails/day; 1 user, 3 days email logs, 1 domain.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: Starts at $15/mo for 10,000 emails ($20/mo 50K, $30/mo 100K), $1 per 1,000 overage; 3 users, 5 days email logs, 5 domains, no dedicated IP.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: Best value. Starts at $85/mo for 100,000 emails ($200/250K, $300/500K, $450/750K), $0.88 per 1,000 overage; 100 users, 15 days email logs, 100 domains, dedicated IP included.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Starts at $750/mo for 1.5M emails ($1,250/mo for 2.5M, custom for unlimited); 30 days email logs, priority support, custom contracts, unlimited user seats. Higher/custom volumes are quote-only.

vendors.name: SMTP2GO
vendors.provenance: https://www.smtp2go.com/pricing/ (official pricing page, accessed 2026-06-13; flat monthly plans bundling email volume with per-1,000 overage; annual billing gives 2 months free, ~16.7%)

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: 1,000 emails/month, 200/day, 25/hour (hourly cap removed with a verified sender domain); 5 days reporting, 5 verified senders, 2 team members.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: 10,000 emails/month included, $1 per 1,000 overage; 30 days reporting, subaccount management, SMS, full support. $100/yr (~$8.33/mo, 2 months free).

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Recommended. 100,000 emails/month included, $0.85 per 1,000 overage; dedicated IP, email testing tools, 30 days reporting, SMS. $750/yr (~$62.50/mo, 2 months free).

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: Quote-only; enterprise tier for 3,000,000+ emails/month, personalized setup, enterprise support, dedicated IP. Contact sales.
